targetMetrics.source: User-installed Windows Iosevka; normal-width Regular/Italic and Bold/Bold Italic in SGr-Iosevka collections
targetMetrics.note: Both hhea and OS/2 typographic metrics give a 1250-unit line. Terminal cells use the full typographic box. Accent limits leave 10 units of padding inside it. Reference measurements guide calibration; original Inconsolata glyphs and independent spacing checks determine the outputs.

outlineBalance.method: Pair corresponding perpendicular stroke measurements in original and resized cubic contours. Preserve the original stroke contrast under a common affine stem scale, compensate only the extra distortion from height fitting, keep smooth joins and all advances, and reject proposals that worsen source-relative width balance or introduce contour warnings. No character-name rules.

outlineCleanup.method: Repair only newly introduced contour intersections/directions; retain other outlines. No glyph-specific redrawing.
outlineCleanup.permittedCutDifference: max(2 units per filled interval, 1.5% of filled span length)

digitAnchors.method: Separate fallback mark lookup for digits, inserted before upstream lookups; original letter anchors retained

terminalSymbols.method: New geometric one-cell sort triangles, direct rasterization; every existing glyph, mapping, hint and layout table preserved.
